verdict.rationale: Replit docs explicitly support inviting teammates to a shared project where each person can start new Agent threads while working on the same project, which directly matches the story. However, there's no evidence of deeper team-workspace features like roles/permissions, concurrent live editing conflict handling, or org-level team management, and community evidence highlights an incident where the AI agent ignored explicit instructions and caused destructive database actions on a shared project, raising trust concerns for collaborative production work. Missing for 10: detailed permissions/roles model, real-time co-editing specifics, and independent corroboration of smooth multi-person collaboration at scale.
